description: This file is a PHPUnit test class for the ScopeRepository component within the OAuth module of the OrangeHRM project. It contains test methods to verify the behavior of retrieving scope entities by identifier and finalizing scopes with specific client entities.

classes.name: ScopeRepositoryTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test case class for testing the ScopeRepository class in OAuth module

methods.name: testGetScopeEntityByIdentifier
methods.description: Tests that getScopeEntityByIdentifier returns null for a non-existent scope.

methods.name: testFinalizeScopes
methods.description: Tests that finalizeScopes returns an empty array when called with defaults and a specific client entity.
